name: M3 x 10 countersunk screw
summary: Sits flush in a 90 degree countersink, head 6.72 mm across. 10 mm long overall.
source: ISO 10642 values for M3: theoretical head diameter 6.72 mm, head height 1.86 mm, 90 degree head. Unlike a cap screw, a countersunk screw is measured including its head, so 10 mm is the whole screw.
